preservation_source.assurance: The map is structural traceability, not proof of semantic equivalence. Independent QA reconstructs the source obligations and judges current mechanics and prose.

obligations.intent: Open one draft PR as the Build claim and keep construction draft.
Plan work as an ordered sequence before implementation.
Store same-session plans locally and require durable authority for unattended continuation.
Derive review coverage from installed persona role and lens metadata.
Disclose zero installed reviewers rather than claim a green review.
obligations.anchor: No installed reviewer is a disclosed no-extra-review result

obligations.intent: Judge Codex adapter changes against the governing decision and live validation procedure.
Title PRs using the Kind prefix contract.
Use impact, installed coverage, neighbours, and nearby trouble to propose review depth.
Derive suggested depth from risk rather than prior operator preference.
Relay a plain-language risk surface without invented time or cost.
obligations.anchor: Never a time or a cost figure

obligations.intent: Reserve guardrail acknowledgement to the operator and distinguish killswitch from disclosure tiers.
Approve plan and review depth together before implementation.
Retain a one-headline fast path for genuinely trivial reversible no-spec work.
Run cold plan review before implementation at approved coverage.
Require every reported finding to receive an orchestrator disposition.
Return an unresolved reviewer-labelled blocking finding to the operator.
obligations.anchor: This supersedes the older automatic rule
obligations.replacement: A non-blocking adjudication remains orchestrator-owned but must be disclosed on the PR merge surface with the concern and rationale.

obligations.intent: Choose inline, isolated-worker, or Routine implementation according to cohesion and context pressure.
Keep the orchestrator as single writer and integrate worker output for cohesion.
Re-dispatch or complete a failed worker's missing work without phantom workflow state.
List and disposition deferred-work markers in touched areas.
Use focused tests during implementation and the full suite once on the cohesive candidate.
Reconcile the live base before submission.
Regenerate knowledge graph and self-map last; never side-pick derived conflicts.
Disclose regenerated-index count and that no work was lost.
Validate before spending cold deliverable review.
Run frozen CI validation and serial self-tests.
Preserve complete validation diagnostics and readable self-test logs.
Record the exact commit reviewed by deliverable reviewers.
Invalidate validation after every code change.
Measure reviewed-to-final divergence and require a none, scoped, or full engineering judgment.
Allow scoped repair review and a terminating no-review judgment without recursion.
Apply the same proportional judgment after base reconciliation.
Run plan-derived conformance even without a settled specification.
Re-derive every applicable hard-check not-applicable declaration during deliverable review.
Read and fill the literal PR template including its consent preamble.
obligations.replacement: The coordinator's contract composer assembles the whole body from the template and a typed claim; a composed body is verified against the real pr-body-completeness gate. Manual template-filling remains the documented human fallback.

obligations.intent: Run close-linkage comparison and disclose or narrowly defang contradictions.
Render the report-only change profile and falsifiable Behaviors.
Provide an operator-runnable demonstration or an honest non-behavioral reason.
Mark ready only with current validation, review, findings, repair judgment, preflights, and PR contract.
Never merge; readiness hands the claim to the operator.
Make the Review record operator-readable and disclose review code execution.
State reviewed and final commits, divergence, consequence, and re-review result.
Include the unresolved-conversation pre-arm before merge.
obligations.anchor: A merge blocked by an unresolved review conversation
obligations.replacement: The standing notice is no longer folded into every pull request. The unresolved-conversation guidance is surfaced only when a merge is actually blocked — when the operator reports a greyed merge button with all checks green — by rendering unresolved_conversation_notice.py from the boot-session-start.md recovery path; the engine never resolves the conversation for the operator, and the protected-branch conversation-resolution rule that blocks merging is unchanged.

obligations.intent: Keep every installed review lens connected to a Build stage.
Offer lossless stranded-PR reconciliation at the next session.
Use the same workflow across unattended Routine fires with planned cohesion restored at Finalize.
Keep Routine decomposability an explicit Plan-time judgment.
Represent ordered Routine items and permitted scope durably without changing the plan digest for progress.
Emit product build-order milestones and check phase readiness when applicable.
Resolve settled descriptions and map every canonical criterion before approval.
Use the same exact settled criteria in plan review, deliverable review, and operator acceptance steps.
Route product-description authoring to product intake rather than informal Build prose.
Use direct verified worktrees for products the operator owns.
Run product tools inside the product worktree and pin GitHub writes to the verified slug.
Scan mechanic-local references before owned-product submission.
Clean completed owned-product worktrees safely and stale sprawl only with consent.
obligations.anchor: Never remove it while it has unpushed commits

obligations.intent: Preserve non-reflexivity while allowing unmerged product work to be built.
Use the contribution path for targets the operator does not own and disclose review honestly.
Disclose recognized-automation PR-body checks as not applicable without confusing guardrail acknowledgement.
Surface open fail-open findings distinctly in Validation.
Surface unavailable live helpers using the canonical provider diagnosis.
Build every touched slice to full agreed capability and record explicit deferrals.
Write genuine deferred work at the code site using the governed marker grammar.
Ground load-bearing claims and delegated findings against first-hand authority.
Synthesize plan-review findings into one recommended call with its tradeoff before involving the operator.
A DAG worker result binds only to its claim's attempt id and base SHA; a stale or superseded attempt's result is rejected.
Every work-verb write compare-and-swaps against the current snapshot revision; a stale write is refused, never silently merged.
A DAG node completes only through an integration commit proven on the PR branch with recorded focused verification; a returned worker artifact is never completion by itself.
